cb89c28f5d22d6a2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج العربي للصيانة والمقاولات عن فني نظم حاسب آلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم وتحليل النظم، وتوثيق الإجراءات، والمساهمة في تصميم فرعيات النظم. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات اللازمة من مصادرها المختلفة وإعداد النماذج الخاصة بذلك. دراسة وتحليل وحدات جزئية من النظم وفقاً لاحتياجات المستخدمين، وإعداد النماذج الأولية للدراسة التحليلية. متابعة ومراقبة وتوثيق إجراءات فحص النظم، بالإضافة إلى إعداد أدلة الاستخدام التفصيلية. تصميم فرعيات النظم، مثل شاشات الإدخال والإخراج، وتوثيق هذه الفرعيات بدقة. إعداد نماذج المواصفات الفنية للبرامج والمشاركة في تقدير الكلفة المالية للنظم. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال نظم الحاسب الآلي أو ما يعادله. القدرة على جمع وتحليل البيانات والمعلومات بدقة. فهم جيد لمبادئ تصميم النظم وتوثيق الإجراءات. المهارات الأساسية مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية وتوثيق العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع مختلف الأطراف. الالتزام بالدقة والتفاصيل في جميع المهام الموكلة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني نظم الحاسب الآلي ضمن فريق شركة الخليج العربي للصيانة والمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير المهارات المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

cbaac8712694759a.job_title: AFCAP V : SWA Logistics Technician (Secret Clearance)
cbaac8712694759a.description: About the Role KBR is seeking a SWA Logistics Technician with Secret Clearance to join the AFCAP V Program in Riyadh and Al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position supports the * Air Force by providing essential logistics services, including inventory management, property accountability, and equipment movement across Southwest Asia operations. Program Context The AFCAP V Program assists the * Air Force with Southwest Asia Logistics Support (SWA Log). KBR delivers comprehensive services that include inventory management, property accountability, equipment movement, and logistics coordination. Beyond SWA Logistics, KBR also provides Engineering Support, NTV Leasing, LAMS, Power Production, BOS-I, and various quality-of-life solutions to sustain base operations. Key Responsibilities Perform property accountability, inventory management, equipment handling, and warehouse support. Coordinate transportation and manage BEAR equipment yard operations at the assigned location. Maintain accurate records for BEAR equipment, Mission Ready Spares Packages (MRSP), R-14 accountable property, R-15 consumable items, Airfield Damage Repair (ADR) equipment, tools, and shop equipment. Utilize automated inventory equipment and prepare logistics documentation. Coordinate equipment movements and support the receipt, shipment, transfer, and disposition of Government property. Conduct monthly physical inventories and compare them against accountability records to identify discrepancies. Update inventory records and ensure timely submission of monthly inventory reports. Record shipments, receipts, transfers, turn-ins, and DLA Disposition Services transactions. Research missing items through physical inspections, record reviews, and coordination with personnel. Support the Primary Equipment Custodian with R-14 and R-15 property-accountability requirements. Initiate transfer-of-accountability requests, equipment turn-in requests, and disposition actions. Prepare DD Form 1149 shipment documentation and coordinate with the Transportation Management Office. Schedule pickup and delivery appointments and perform physical movement of property using a Contractor-provided pickup truck. Track accountable tools and shop equipment using barcode scanners, laptops, asset tags, and automated inventory-management software. Maintain transaction suspense logs and follow up on open logistics actions. Monitor deployed equipment listings, redistribution orders, and property-transfer actions. Maintain continuity files and supporting records for all property transactions. Organize the BEAR equipment yard, segregating equipment by type, condition, and serviceability code. Load and unload trucks, assist with equipment re-warehousing, and operate forklifts (4,000, 6,000, and 10,000-pound) when authorized. Coordinate the transfer of unserviceable equipment and excess property to DLA Disposition Services. Assist with recommendations for replacement, redistribution, or disposition of BEAR and WRM assets. Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment, property discrepancies, and operational concerns to site leadership. Adhere to all installation safety, security, tool-control, and property-accountability requirements. Perform other assigned logistics and property-management duties. Work Environment and Benefits This is a full-time position based in Riyadh and Al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia. KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits, which may include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending accounts, disability, paid time off, or a flexible work schedule. KBR supports career advancement through professional training and development opportunities.

cb37558ed3e221ad.description: Job Summary We are seeking a Business Continuity Specialist to develop, implement, maintain, and test Business Continuity Management (BCM) plans and operational resilience frameworks. Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Higher Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related science discipline. Strong communication skills with command of written and spoken English.

Ensure compliance with Egyptian tax laws and Saudi regulations including ZATCA, VAT, withholding tax, and Zakat. Oversee budgeting, cash flow management, forecasting, and financial analysis. Monitor intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and treasury activities. Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and banking partners. Lead and support the accounting team across both countries. Strengthen internal controls and improve financial processes and ERP utilization. Support management with financial insights, KPI reporting, and strategic planning.
